properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: JWA identifier constants RS256/RS384/RS512 (RSASSA-PKCS1-v1_5) and PS256/PS384/PS512 (RSASSA-PSS) at DigitalSignaturesAlgorithm.cs:16-21, wired into the Algorithm registry as AlgorithmType.RSA signature algorithms (Algorithm.cs:35-43); keys come from RSA.Create() keygen (3072-bit default). All Shor-vulnerable; migrate to ML-DSA-65 or SLH-DSA-SHA2-128s. Changeable here — this is the library's own supported-algorithm surface.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: HS256/HS384/HS512 constants (DigitalSignaturesAlgorithm.cs:12-14), wired as AlgorithmType.HMAC (Algorithm.cs:28-33) and chosen as the factory default for HMAC JWS (Algorithm.cs:132). Live key generation: CreateHmacSecurityKey (CryptoService.cs:68-75) creates HMACSHA256/384/512 over 64/128-byte CSPRNG keys. Symmetric MACs are not Shor-vulnerable (Grover at most halves strength; ≥256-bit keys remain adequate). Test/CHANGELOG mentions in the site list are fixtures/prose; the src sites are the asset

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: CreateRsaSecurityKey (CryptoService.cs:15-21): RSA.Create(keySize) with default keySize=3072 bits; KeyId from CSPRNG. Keys back RS*/PS* JWT signing and RSA-OAEP/AES-KW JWE. Shor-vulnerable; 3072-bit meets classical minimums; migrate to ML-DSA-65 (signing) / ML-KEM-768 (encryption).

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: 'RSA-OAEP' constant (EncryptionAlgorithmKey.cs:14), accepted by the Algorithm registry (Algorithm.cs:17) and selected as the DEFAULT key-encryption algorithm for RSA-type JWE, paired with A128CBC-HS256 content encryption (Algorithm.cs:138). Shor-vulnerable PKE; migrate to ML-KEM-768. Note the sibling identifier RsaPKCS1='RSA1_5' (line 13) is deprecated (Bleichenbacher) and is reported as a separate finding since no object covers it.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Constants ES256/384/512 (DigitalSignaturesAlgorithm.cs:9-11); registry wiring (Algorithm.cs:21-26); factory default AlgorithmType.ECDsa → ES256 on the P-256 curve (Algorithm.cs:131); kty mapping to EllipticCurve (:110); live keygen ECDsa.Create(GetNamedECCurve(curve)) (CryptoService.cs:40) dispatched from KeyMaterial.cs:16 and exported to JWK via JsonWebKeyConverter (KeyMaterial.cs:31). Shor-vulnerable; migrate to ML-DSA-65.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: ES256/ES384/ES512 constants (DigitalSignaturesAlgorithm.cs:9-11), wired as AlgorithmType.ECDsa (Algorithm.cs:21-26); ES256 on P-256 is the factory default for ECDsa JWS keys (Algorithm.cs:131). Shor-vulnerable (elliptic-curve discrete log); migrate to ML-DSA-65.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: GetNamedECCurve maps JWK crv 'P-256' to ECCurve.NamedCurves.nistP256 (CryptoService.cs:113), fed to ECDsa.Create (line 40) for ES256 signing keys. Shor-vulnerable curve; signature keys migrate to ML-DSA-65.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: GetNamedECCurve: P-384→nistP384 (CryptoService.cs:114), P-521→nistP521 (:116), and the non-standard 'P512' alias→nistP521 (:115, comment: 'treat 512 as 521. It was a bug in .NET Release'); GetCurveType maps ES384→P-384 and ES512→P-521 (:51-52). Shor-vulnerable NIST curves; migrate to ML-DSA-65.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Spans: HS256/384/512 constants (DigitalSignaturesAlgorithm.cs:12-14); Algorithm registry cases (Algorithm.cs:28-30); factory default HS256 for HMAC JWS (Algorithm.cs:132); live HMAC keygen HMACSHA256/384/512 over 64/128-byte CSPRNG keys (CryptoService.cs:72-74); HS256/HS512 inside the composite A128CBC-HS256/A256CBC-HS512 content-encryption identifiers (EncryptionAlgorithmContent.cs:18-20) — the CBC-HS family is AES-CBC + HMAC-SHA composite (MAC provides integrity); JWKS export via ConvertFromSy

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Aes128KW 'A128KW' (EncryptionAlgorithmKey.cs:11); Aes128CbcHmacSha256 'A128CBC-HS256' (EncryptionAlgorithmContent.cs:18); Aes128Gcm 'A128GCM' (:21); registry cases Algorithm.cs:11,86-87; factory default for AES-type JWE = Aes128KW + A128CBC-HS256 (Algorithm.cs:139); live 128-bit keygen (CryptoService.cs:88-97). AES is not Shor-vulnerable; Grover halves AES-128 to ~64-bit effective — long-term prefer the A256 variants. Test sites are fixtures.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Aes128Gcm 'A128GCM' (EncryptionAlgorithmContent.cs:21), Aes192Gcm 'A192GCM' (:22), Aes256Gcm 'A256GCM' (:23); accepted by the Algorithm registry (Algorithm.cs:87,91) as JWE content-encryption algorithms. AEAD — not Shor-vulnerable; Grover halves AES-128. Test InlineData entries in the site list are fixtures.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: CreateAESSecurityKey (CryptoService.cs:86-98): Aes.Create() with KeySize 128 (A128KW) or 256 (A256KW) resolved from the chosen algorithm, GenerateKey() over the CSPRNG; wrapped as SymmetricSecurityKey (KeyMaterial.cs:61-68). AES is not Shor-vulnerable; Grover halves strength (AES-128 → ~64-bit effective), so prefer 256-bit keys long-term.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: DatabaseJsonWebKeyStore.DeterministicId (:67-74): SHA-256 over 'use:kty:previousId' truncated to 16 bytes → Guid for SecurityKeys rows, so concurrent replicas derive colliding primary keys instead of multiplying keys. Identity derivation for storage, not a security control — but it is the hash primitive in the key-store path; SHA-256 remains adequate.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Aes256KW 'A256KW' (EncryptionAlgorithmKey.cs:12); Aes256CbcHmacSha512 'A256CBC-HS512' (EncryptionAlgorithmContent.cs:20); Aes256Gcm 'A256GCM' (:23); registry cases Algorithm.cs:12,90-91; live 256-bit keygen (CryptoService.cs:92,96). AES-256 remains adequate under Grover. Test sites are fixtures.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: RandomNumberGenerator.Fill (CryptoService.cs:127) in CreateRandomKey: sources HMAC keys (64/128 bytes), AES content-encryption keys, and unique key IDs (CreateUniqueId → Base64UrlEncoder). Secure randomness source; no weakness; not quantum-relevant.
